user.title: SolisCloud
user.description: Enter the API URL, Key ID and Key Secret issued by Solis.

error.invalid_auth: The Key ID or Key Secret was rejected. Check both for stray whitespace.
error.clock_skew: SolisCloud rejected the request timestamp. Check this machine's clock and timezone.
error.rate_limited: SolisCloud is rate limiting this IP (three calls per five seconds). Wait a moment and retry.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SolisCloud. The API is often slow; try again.
error.api_error: SolisCloud returned an error. See the Home Assistant log for the code and message.
error.no_inverters: Connected successfully, but the account returned no inverters. Check the API URL is the right region.

abort.already_configured: This Key ID is already configured.

data_description.sign_convention: Zählpfeilsystem for signed power sensors. EZS: positive means power delivered (generating, exporting, discharging). VZS: positive means power consumed (importing, charging). Cumulative energy counters stay positive either way.
